dashboard.welcome: Welcome to Account V2! Let us guide you through the main features.
dashboard.stats: Find your balances here (bank, upcoming, and forecast) for the current period.
dashboard.evolution: Track your balance evolution and compare income and expenses month after month.
dashboard.breakdown: Visualize at a glance your spending distribution by category compared to your budget.
dashboard.transactions: Check your latest operations here. Colors indicate if you're on track.
dashboard.add_btn: Use this button (or the Enter key) to quickly add a new operation.

account.intro: Setting up an account involves several steps to ensure accurate management.
account.name: Give your account a clear name (e.g., Checking, Savings).
account.create_btn: Click here to create a new account.
account.balance: Enter your current bank balance to start on the right foot.
account.type: Choose the account type to adapt calculations and display.
account.categories: Set up your expense and income categories to organize your transactions.
account.recurring: Schedule your automatic transfers and withdrawals here.
account.periods: Finally, create your budget periods (month by month) to track your goals.

transactions.description: Enter the description. Our AI will suggest a category automatically!
transactions.amount: The amount. Use a minus sign (-) for expenses.
transactions.pending: Check this for pre-authorizations or upcoming payments. They won't count immediately in your reconciled balance.
transactions.shortcuts: Use Shift+Tab to toggle between transaction and transfer, and Enter to save.
